modelNotes: Major-event weighting emphasizes Futures Super Finals for boys and Futures + US Club Championships as peer events for girls.
JO Qualifiers provide recent pre-JO validation.
D1/D2/D3 division-tier guardrails prevent lower-division winners from over-jumping D1 fields without supporting evidence.
A/B/C team-depth guardrails and alias normalization are applied before publication.
Top-20 non-D1 teams and top-25 depth teams are flagged for manual review.
